scope: Ranked completion and periodic synchronization share one coalesced pass over the existing durable arena outbox, not a waiting worker per result.

Results still reach the journal before world profiles change or participants return. Failure stops the pass and retains receipts for the next request/startup, without a tight retry loop or fake acknowledgement.
Completion return/result presentation no longer waits for Mongo; participant-only outcome and state remain available, with conditional honest sync copy.
Practice/duel results still perform no profile writes. Startup recovery, rating/reward arithmetic, commit idempotency and character journals are unchanged.

evidence: Eight producers make512 requests during a blocked pass: no concurrent consumer and exactly one follow-up pass, with drained pending/running state.
Injected consumer failure leaves the actual disk receipt and rating unchanged; a later request consumes it through a simulated successful consumer, not a claimed Mongo commit.
Sealed work admission retains pending state without executing or acknowledging rejected work.

Both participants receive return scene, result, private state and pending-sync copy while the consumer is blocked; a nonparticipant gets nothing. Existing practice/no-write and queue/cleanup/save regressions pass.
Existing game/journal checks preserve frozen durable-before-return results, revision precedence, detached checksummed receipts and conflict rejection.

connectedBinary.build: Go1.27.1 with race detector and fixture health identity buildCommit=server; inherited Alpha1.70 defaults, not a1.72 deployment.
connectedBinary.scope: Four actual socket participants: disconnect/forfeit ranked result, ordinary resume, saved profile/penalty and process restart. This is not a four-player dungeon clear or full combat-round balance run.
connectedBinary.storage: Verified eidolon.qa.scope=arena-sync-20261002 and Mounts=[], bounded512MiB/32MiB tmpfs, memory/CPU caps and loopback-only Mongo port.
connectedBinary.cleanup: Stopped and removed only the exact inspected task container after completion. Synthetic tmpfs accounts are gone; binary/process-log artifacts retained. No production account/data/service or global Docker cache changed.

limits: One bounded real-match disconnect/resume/restart fixture, not exhaustive PvP, campaign, load, public-proxy or production deployment acceptance. Earlier account/resource receipts retain their source scopes.
This bounds arena synchronization passes, not total journal size, per-match UI update workers, guild completion or weekly-raid delivery work. Those boundaries remain separate.
No 1.72 version promotion, CI publication, player-capacity certification or campaign/pacing acceptance.
